description: Test suite for the Job store in Mattermost, including various test cases for saving, retrieving, updating, deleting, and querying jobs with different filters and pagination.

methods.name: testJobSaveGet
methods.description: Tests saving a job and retrieving it by ID, verifying data consistency.

methods.name: testJobSaveOnce
methods.description: Tests concurrent SaveOnce operations ensuring only one job is saved for a given key.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByType
methods.description: Tests retrieving all jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieving jobs filtered by type and status.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByTypePage
methods.description: Tests paginated retrieval of jobs by type, verifying order and pagination.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByTypesPage
methods.description: Tests retrieving jobs of multiple types with pagination.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByTypeAndStatusPage
methods.description: Tests paginated retrieval of jobs filtered by type and status.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByTypesAndStatusesPage
methods.description: Tests complex filtering with multiple types and statuses with pagination.

methods.name: testJobGetAllByStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieving all jobs with a specific status.

methods.name: testJobStoreGetNewestJobByStatusAndType
methods.description: Tests retrieving the newest job by status and type.

methods.name: testJobStoreGetNewestJobByStatusesAndType
methods.description: Tests retrieving the newest job by multiple statuses and type.

methods.name: testJobStoreGetCountByStatusAndType
methods.description: Tests counting jobs filtered by status and type.

methods.name: testJobUpdateOptimistically
methods.description: Tests optimistic update of a job's fields.

methods.name: testJobUpdateStatusUpdateStatusOptimistically
methods.description: Tests optimistic status updates with concurrency considerations.

methods.name: testJobDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a job by ID.

methods.name: testJobCleanup
methods.description: Tests cleanup of jobs based on creation time and status.

methods.name: testJobGetByTypeAndData
methods.description: Tests retrieving jobs by type and specific data fields, including multiple filters and status filtering.
